text: IMD Severe Marine Weather Warning: A well-marked depression over the Northwest Bay of Bengal is generating squally surface wind speeds of 50-60 kmph gusting to 70 kmph with rough-to-very-rough sea conditions along the Odisha coast. Fishermen and small mechanized trawlers are strictly prohibited from venturing into the sea until Saturday, 26th September 2026, 18:00 IST.
IMD Flash Flood Watch: Teesta and Karala river catchments under alert. Heavy rainfall will persist through Friday noon, 25th September 2026.
